title: [Main]error in allocation account function
summary: Fixes bug 655888, an error in the allocation account function, by changing Purchase Alloc. Acc. Mgt. (W1 and ES) and Alloc. Acc. Handle Doc. Post (W1). New end-to-end purchase allocation account tests are added in W1, IT, NL and NO.
